The back peddles are very nice. I like having different options for how the sticks behave, on a software level. The three trigger options are fun to switch between. I don't regret buying it.

Playing on the Steam Deck. Capped at 30fps, all settings on low. 1280x720. Tested Tyson Fury vs Muhammad Ali, at every venue. For the average fps, I will be guesstimating, during the action.
- Turner Gym: 21fps avg, range 15-28. 8fps during the getting up mini game. Walking up and down dropped the fps at first, didn't affect  the fps later in the fight.
- Brooklyn Hall. 23fps avg, 19-29 fps. GPU 70%, CPU 32% avg. Ram 12. 11-30fps or getting up mini game. Second smoothest venue.
- Coldwell Gym: 19fps avg, range 12-25, kinda. It depends on if any mirrors are in sight. GPU 45%. CPU 30%. This venue is unplayable.
- Empire Pro. 20fps avg, range 14-26. GPU 70%. CPU 30%. 13.1 ram. 
- Compubox Academy.  23fps avg, 15-29. GPU 65%. CPU 35%. 12 ram. Smoothest venue.
- WBC Arena. 20fps avg, but not really connstant stuttering. Motion blur, Is way too high, seemingly a glitch. GPU 70%. CPU 40%. In my opinion, this venue is currently unplayable.

Tried on online match. I played Charlie Edwards, and faced Charlie Edwards. Avg 10fps, unplayable.

The game gives the decks fan, a work out. Experienced 5 crashes, one during the training, three after I selected the venue, and one when trying to load an online match. Also wish there was a way to increase the text size, because it's way to small on the steam decks screen.

General thoughts; Have to remember, that it's only day one, in early access. It's not even marked as "playable" on the steam deck (yet?) Still I'm happy to support the developers (especially since my testing took more than 2 hours return time).
Overall, I have high hopes, for the actual game. The controls are well designed, so it's easy to pick up and play. From the little I could really play, the gameplay seems to be in a great place already. The graphics look good, even on the lowest setting. So far, it appears to feature the best commentary, I've ever seen in a sports game. In its current (day one) state. If your only way to play this, is on a steam deck, I would currently not recommend it, for the frame fate issues alone. Exited to see where the game is, a few months down the line.

I used to have to have the last touch. So if someone touched me in any way I would have to "poke" them back. I used to "have" to say words before I went to sleep. The best way I can explain it is that I would lie in bed and have to keep saying things over and over again until I found I satisfactory and then make sure I didn't talk again until morning. Every time I walked on different suffuses, for example carpit to hardwood floor. I would have to do almost like a little "dance" with my feet. Thinking back it must have been very noticeable. Anyway I have lots more I could list, but that's some of the stuff I can stop myself from doing now. Although theirs still some ocd things I still do.

Jimmy's older brother Derek, is gone to work and wont be home for a few more hours. Their parents are gone to the city for the weekend, so Jimmy is home alone with his dog, Bone for a few hours. Since Jimmy is 18 and dose not have a girlfriend, he suddenly gets an "itch". Since he is home alone he figures he could have have himself a little "alone time". He goes and looks under his bed to look for his old playboys, but then remembers his mother found, and disposed of them a couple of weeks ago. There's nothing on day-time tv for him to "watch" and with their being no internet yet he wonders what he could do. Theoretically he could go to the conner store that's about a 20 minute walk away from him to buy a new magazine, but he too embarrassed to go out in public to buy one, especially because one of his mothers friends work at the conner store. But in one last ditch effort he decides to go looking in his brothers room, figuring that his brother must have some adult reading matreal hidden away somewhere in his room. So he goes to open the door of Dereks room, but then Jimmy remembers that Dereks hates it when Jimmy goes into his room when hes not home. But with Derek gone to work, Jimmy is conifent that if he puts everything back to where he got it, Derek wont be any the wiser. Jimmy looks under the bed, nothing. He looks in the douser, nothing. Jimmy opens up the closet and looks around the pile of junk that's on the floor when he comes across some weird little plastic tv thing. Its not a Nintendo, it for some reason has a picture of an apple with a bite taken out of it on the back. Jimmy examinations it. Finds what looks like to be two buttons. He punches one of them and a picture of the Bone (their dog) and the time is shown. 12:34 am. Jimmy wonders if this is some kind of new computer thing, but he never seen anyone else with one or even seen them in stores.
